provenance: Original synthetic arithmetic examples. Not measured material data, calibrated climate parameters, or copied Mapgen2/Mapgen4 presets.
purpose: Optional worked examples for generation-recipes.md, authored-terrain-and-climate.md and terrain-map-rendering.md. This is an illustrative fixture format, not a required game schema.

noise_shaping.assumption: Input field is finite and lies in [-1, 1]; convert once to unsigned before the power transform.

terrace.tie_rule: Halfway values round toward the larger elevation, including negative heights.

island_border_blend.assumption: Blend is applied after all other bounded elevation detail; t is a clamped coordinate across the declared perimeter band.
island_border_blend.boundary_note: Boundary elevation below sea level is a shape constraint; initializing seawater still requires declared water state and boundary connectivity. Resolve the perimeter in the actual surface representation.

stationary_target_height_brush.assumption: Fixed brush center, target, weight and k over the interval. Frame subdivision equality does not imply invariance to arbitrary moving-cursor sampling.

rainfall_and_steady_routing.assumption: Two disjoint upstream areas, runoff coefficient one, no other sources or losses. A zero-area junction receives each upstream discharge exactly once. This steady/instantaneous routing diagnostic has no transient storage or travel-time dynamics.
rainfall_and_steady_routing.runtime_note: Do not add the accumulated junction discharge as a second rainfall source in a transient water solver.

temperature_initialization.assumption: An illustrative altitude rule for initial climate, not a universal lapse rate or a time-dependent atmospheric model.

bilinear_palette.note: A nonzero interaction vector prevents one affine color rule from fitting all four corners exactly. Display-only values have no physical ownership.
